entries.definition: Repairs modules while deployed; cannot repair the Power Plant and cannot repair itself without another AFMU.
A station, outpost, settlement or installation controlled by a minor faction.
The station, outpost, settlement, or other faction asset staked for transfer in a conflict. Winning a conflict does not automatically transfer every asset the loser owns.
Combat and operations against Thargoids.
The faction deliberately selected to gain influence in a precision-transfer operation. Often paired with one selected victim faction.
Elite Dangerous system that tracks minor-faction influence, states, conflicts, control and other strategic conditions.
Positive economic state associated with strong economic activity and favorable trade conditions.
Negative economic state associated with poor economic conditions.
Positive security state associated with lawful, stable conditions.
Negative security state associated with instability and crime.
A combat-scored best-of-seven conflict between factions sharing the same home system when the pairing would otherwise resolve as War.
A practical BGS term for the point where the trailing faction no longer has enough remaining conflict days to force at least a draw, so the conflict can end early.
One tick-scored result in a War, Civil War, or Election. Conflicts are best-of-seven daily contests and can end early when the trailing side can no longer force a draw.

entries.expanded: Influence Lock During War / Civil War / Election
entries.definition: While a faction is in an active conflict, its ordinary system influence is frozen. BGS operators can use this intentionally to reduce the number of movable factions or let another faction leapfrog past the locked pair.
The separate BGS scoring used to decide each day of an active War, Civil War, or Election. It is not the same as ordinary faction influence.
Combat instance associated with a war or civil war.
Common shorthand for the Power Distributor and its SYS/ENG/WEP capacitors.
External ship-building and engineering planner used to model complete builds.
A non-combat best-of-seven conflict between election-compatible government ethos groups, scored through non-combat/economic activity.
A hidden/derived government grouping used by the BGS to decide whether a conflict resolves as an Election or War. Common groups are Criminal, Autocratic, Corporate, and Social.
A state through which a minor faction can spread into another eligible system.
Core module used for supercruise and hyperspace jumps.
Highest normal engineering grade for a blueprint.
Signal source commonly used to gather high-grade manufactured engineering materials.

entries.expanded: Hyperspace jump to another star system
entries.definition: Often contrasted with low waking back into supercruise.
Optional internal module that increases hull integrity and can also influence resistances when engineered.

entries.expanded: Defense strategy designed to continue fighting after shields fail
entries.definition: Relies on armour, HRPs, MRPs, module placement/protection, and often repair planning.
In BGS mission rewards, the Influence reward level; context matters because this is not the same as faction influence percentage.
A percentage representing relative faction standing within one system; distinct from mission INF reward pips.
Expansion into a full system that requires defeating an eligible incumbent faction.
Raising a faction past one or more factions whose influence is frozen in conflict, avoiding separate crossover conflicts with those locked factions during the window.
Severe negative security state that can restrict station services.

entries.expanded: Return to supercruise within the same system
entries.definition: Often easier to mass-lock than a high wake.
A local political faction that can hold influence, states and assets in one or more systems.
Optional internal that absorbs a share of module damage after shields fall.
A faction in its home system; it cannot normally be removed from that home by Retreat.
Common shorthand for an Overcharged engineering blueprint; exact meaning depends on the module.
High-damage fixed weapon dealing a mixed damage profile.
A state has been triggered and is queued to become active after its pending period.
Active management of distributor pips to change shield resistance, engine performance, and weapon recharge.
A minor faction associated with a player group; mechanically it participates in the BGS like other minor factions.
Ambiguous shorthand. In ship-building discussions it often means Power Plant; in strategic discussions it may mean Powerplay.
Cooldown period after some states during which the same state may not immediately retrigger.
A state that can remove a non-native faction from a system if retreat conditions persist.
Maintaining distance while flying backward and keeping weapons on an approaching target; especially discussed in PvP.
The practical reduction in BGS return from repeatedly filling the same activity bucket during one tick. Mixing valid levers is generally more efficient than endlessly repeating one activity.
Optional internal that restores shield strength while active and produces significant heat.
FSD capability that allows a temporary high-speed supercruise boost at substantial fuel and heat cost.

entries.expanded: Defense strategy centered on maintaining a large/effective shield
entries.definition: Usually supported by boosters, resistances, SCBs, or regeneration depending on build.
Fighter deployed from a Fighter Hangar.
Ground vehicle deployed from a Planetary Vehicle Hangar.
A practical way to group simultaneous faction pressures such as economy, security, conflict, expansion/retreat, and event states.
The three Power Distributor capacitor groups controlled with pips.
The recurring simulation update in which faction influence and many state changes are processed.
How long it takes a build or group to destroy a target under the conditions being discussed.
The faction deliberately selected to lose influence in a precision-transfer operation. This is operational shorthand, not an in-game status.
A combat-scored best-of-seven conflict between factions of incompatible ethos groups or involving Anarchy/Criminal ethos.
